scientific_integrity: The self-review relies on a complete mathematical proof using matroid shellability, an integral exact sequence, finite full-group checks, and comparison with published Mathieu characters; no independent assessment was performed.
scientific_limitations: Homotopy wedge is not equivariant. The irreducible decomposition concerns complexification of top rational homology, not an integral lattice decomposition. Equivalent unindexed results cannot be ruled out.
title: Multiplicity-free Mathieu symmetry in the Witt hexad-avoiding complex
